reviewedBy: Claude (Opus 5), session 57b768fe, reading the /collect draft output with Jacob Kennedy
review: DISCONTINUED IS EXCLUDED, AND IT IS HALF THE CATALOGUE. 30 of 62 products carry the product_type 'Discontinued'. The draft proposed including them because they classify cleanly into battlestation, which they do: they are keyboards, and they are also keyboards the merchant has stopped selling. Shipping them means a shopper clicks a card and lands on a dead product, which is the single worst thing this storefront can do.
That leaves 26 of 62 published. A smaller shelf that works beats a bigger one that sends people to nothing.
REGISTRY PLATFORM WAS WRONG. It said shopify; the capture came back through the WooCommerce Store API. Fourth time in thirteen shops. Corrected.
62 of 63 by the sitemap. The live scrape reads the shop directly rather than replaying this, so the last one arrives if it is still listed.
